Client certificate authentication
sslsplit works fine on sites that do not require server side client certs, if they do it can only handle them with the -P (passthrough) option.
Works when I actually connect to the site and not sslsplit:
curl -k --cert ca.cert.pem --cacert  ca.cert.pem --key key.pem -v https://somesite:8181
Fails when I try to go through sslsplit:
curl -k --cert ca.cert.pem --cacert  ca.cert.pem --key key.pem -v https://localhost:8181
with this error: Error from bufferevent: 0:- 336151570:1042:sslv3 alert bad certificate:20:SSL routines:148:ssl3_read_bytes
packet traces reveal the server is sending a bad certificate error presumably because the client (sslsplit) sent no client cert. The client cert does not appear to be being validated as the certs I am sending are self-signed, but the server is definitely requiring the cert to be there.
It would be nice to be able to specify a default client cert to avoid this. Will look at it.

config.relative_url_root is not recognized in routes (3.2.1)
When using config.relative_url_root = /subfolder, the generated routes are not having the prefix appended. I think that by using config.relative_url_root the routing should automatically place the prefix. It's not very elegant to have to repeat the subfolder by placing a scope :path => "/subfolder" do end in routes.rb.

Add Permalink option for section pages
I have something like the following option in the config.toml:
[permalinks]
posts = "/new-posts/:filename/"

If I visit http://localhost:1313/new-posts/post-name/ I get the intended page. But if I visit http://localhost:1313/new-posts/ I don't get the list page, as I would expect. Instead, I get nothing at all.  I still have to go to http://localhost:1313/posts/ to get the list page.
The version I'm using:
hugo v0.83.1+extended linux/amd64 BuildDate=unknown

I'm not sure if this behavior is intended. But it would be a good idea to have the ability to change the URL of the list pages using the permalinks option as well. Right now, I have to add the url parameter in the front matter of the _index.md to make the list page have the different url.

Screen Space : Overlay render mode not available with Google Cardboard XR plugin
Hi,
We have recently migrated our Unity application from using the GVR SDK to the Google Cardboard XR plugin as an underlying VR framework for our VR application, to resolve the VR render spinning in iOS issue.
We have noticed that there is a difference in how these VR SDKs work,
The Unity UI render modes available for GVR were Screen Space -Overlay, Screen Space :Camera and World Space, allowing the UI to be overlaid and followed around with the user's view/camera, placed in the camera's view frustum and be placed in the World space around the user respectively.
However, in the Google Cardboard XR SDK, only Screen Space: Camera and World Space rendering modes, for the Unity UI to be rendered, are available.
We would like to know whether there is any workaround available to include Screen Space : Overlay mode with Google Cardboard XR, so that we can overlay our UI in the user's view and also be able to render & interact with it in VR, or whether this is an expected behavior of the SDK.
Thanks for the support.

Issue with google VR unity SDK in ios and Migration to cardboard-xr-plugin due to the same
we are developing an app which gives the users an option to add VR content to the app by scanning respective QR codes and play the content by either downloading the video to the device or streaming it directly from the server.
We have implemented these features too and when we started testing the VR content in the devices, its playing correctly in android devices. But in iOS devices with iOS version 14 or above, the video is continuously spinning when we open it in the video player.
On further investigation we got to know that this issue is only there with the iOS devices with OS version 14 or above. in all the other devices with os Version 13 or lower, this issue is not there and we are able to play the video correctly.
After checking multiple blogs and issues in github, we got to know that this issue is happening due to the error in the calibration of gyroscopic sensors in iOS 14 devices.
and a temporary fix to the issue is to toggle the location services and restart the devices. This will reset the gyroscopic sensors But  the temp fix will only last for a few hours or even a few minutes.
